run_paste_contact_maps: run the script to paste together distogram predictions from domain-level pickle files into full-chain contact maps
generate_domains_crop_windows: generate crop domain definitions for a protein target by sliding windows of given sizes across its sequence
get_weights_tfrecord: fetch domain weights from a TFRecord file by reading domain names and their alignment counts
paste_distance_histograms_combine: paste domain-level distance histograms into a combined full-chain contact map weighted by alignment counts
review_paste_distance_histograms: review the paste_distance_histograms function that combines distogram predictions and writes chain-level pickle and RR output files
